run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time forward and backward passes on composed GTN graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward score benchmark to time forward and backward passes on GTN graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for execution on a batch of graphs
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function which benchmarks parallel composition of two sets of GTN linear graphs
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function which benchmarks parallel forward scoring of GTN linear graphs
